messages.text:
BL-901 — A commit can silently delete a backlog ticket it does not own — c9f888d14 swept a staged delete of BL-893 into an unrelated rule-proposal commit and no gate noticed
What it solves: Restoration of the lost ticket is already done and is not part of this
ticket's work: BL-893 was restored in 0405f5d4e with its
`human_approval: approved` and `priority: 44` intact.
Approval context: Two calls worth your sign-off.
First, severity `high` rather than `medium`. The damage is contained and already repaired, which argues for medium — but the failure is SILENT and PERMANENT: the ticket left the tracked tree with no error, no gate, and no log line, and it was recoverable only because …
BL-901 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-901" (or "reject BL-901 <reason>") to act.
